doc.title: Ellen Rowe interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, December 2, 2024

title: Opening greetings and the shared surname
summary: Monk Rowe greets Ellen Rowe, who is in Michigan; they joke about being related.

story.theme_name: Opening the interview: Monk Rowe's welcome and archive boilerplate
story.community_name: Opening the Hamilton College interview: introductions and boilerplate

blocks.x: My name is Monk Rowe and I’m very pleased to have Ellen Rowe with me today, and you’re in Michigan, correct?
Um hum. University yeah, of Michigan.
I’ve seen your name for years and when I first saw it I wondered if I had a long lost relative.
Same here. Same here. I was going back through the family tree but I’m not sure you’re on it.
I think it was Fats Waller who said, “one never knows, do one?”
Well congratulations on your career, I’m going to use the term “illustrious.”
